monsters.name: 「贼灵」巴特鲁斯
monsters.desc: 在翁法罗斯的野地和巷弄间游荡的双子精灵，以窃取财物、捉弄旅人为乐。往往在寻宝者得手在即时捷足先登，徒留的硬币是它无伤大雅的玩笑。

monsters.name: 「贼灵」巴特鲁斯
monsters.desc: The twin sprites roaming the wilds and alleys of Amphoreus, taking pleasure in stealing valuables and playing tricks on travelers. They often outpace Treasure Hunters at the last moment, leaving only a coin as a harmless joke.

monsters.desc: 由「纷争」雕琢的泰坦眷属，流淌着尼卡多利的金血，能承载泰坦灵魂的强大造物。以巨剑抵挡黑潮的侵袭，亦会用巨剑带来战争的侵袭。\n天谴先锋会献祭弱小的眷属，以此暴行换得泰坦的天罚。

monsters.name: 天谴先锋
monsters.desc: A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. They are mighty constructs capable of housing a Titan's soul. With their greatswords, they stand ready to repel the rush of the black tide or turn their blade in a countering onslaught in times of war.\nFuriae Praetor will sacrifice their weaker kin, exchanging atrocity for divine punishments from the Titan.

monsters.name: 蛮神，疯王，纷争的化身
monsters.desc: 「纷争」的泰坦，在疯狂中延续疯狂的战争，乃是翁法罗斯众邦挥之不去的恐惧。\n它也曾身负荣耀的威名，令众邦众神心怀敬意。而那敬畏它的城邦被踏碎，那赞颂它的诗篇被焚毁，只有恶名回荡在无光的末世，玷污全世之座背负的光辉。

monsters.name: 蛮神，疯王，纷争的化身
monsters.desc: The Titan of Strife continues the mad war in their frenzy, becoming the unconquerable fear of the masses of Amphoreus.\nThey once were famed through glory, earning respect from gods and from the people of the land. And yet, the city that revered them was sundered, and the poems that praised their name were destroyed. Only their evil reputation lingers in this lightless era and end times, tainting the Throne of Worlds' brilliance.

Only their evil reputation lingers in this lightless era and end times, tainting the Throne of Worlds's brilliance.

monsters.desc: A supporter of "Strife." Their madness has been tamed by that tenacious soul, and their master remains unwavering ever since.\nLike a war song and the northern wind, they wield their spear with resolution: To decimate enemies, to temper the soldiers, to deliver glory, respect, and determination to their friend and savior.

monsters.name: 颁赐者，千军首，天谴之矛
monsters.desc:
不败者，一切战场的领主，悬锋城与废墟的王，
战车大匠，尸山王座，胜利父，
荣耀僭主，裂地惊海的雷，翁法罗斯的守护者，
纷争的泰坦，天谴之矛，尼卡多利。
全体世间应听遣的将领，永恒且锋利的兵戈，纷争与断绝纷争的法则。
礼赞尼卡多利，最伟大的征服者，最伟大的守护者。

monsters.name: 颁赐者，千军首，天谴之矛
monsters.desc:
The undefeated. The sovereign of all battles. The king of Castrum Kremnos and of ruins,
Grand Artisan of the war chariot, the throne upon a mountain of corpses, and father of victory,
The usurper of glories, the lightning that split the sea, the Guardian of Amphoreus,
The Titan of Strife, the Lance of Fury: Nikador.
A general that all the world should heed, the eternal sharp sword, the law of Strife and of ending Strife.
Praise Nikador, greatest of conquerors, greatest of guardians.

The demigod of Strife, the Lance of Fury, Mydeimos.
A general that all the world should heed, the eternal sharp sword, the law of Strife and of ending Strife.
Praise Mydeimos, greatest of conquerors, greatest of guardians, the strongest of all.

monsters.name: 冥魂渡者，死龙残躯，玻吕刻斯
monsters.desc: 冥河中沉眠的死龙，受炼成召引再度苏醒，化成槁骨腐肉的模样。\n它曾是「死亡」的泰坦，逆溯冥河向上，离开乌有之界于现世搁浅。它曾随冥河潮汐涌上大地，为翁法罗斯的万事万物烙上命定的终局。那些将死的，或已死的存在，皆会因它的归来感受到灵魂深处的颤栗。

monsters.name: 冥魂渡者，死龙残躯，玻吕刻斯（完整）
monsters.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Netherwing: Pollux, the slumbering dragon in the River of Souls, which has been reawakened by an alchemical summoning and morphed into a thing of rot and decay.\nIt once was the Death Titan, swimming upstream in the River of Souls' currents, leaving the realm of non-existence and stranded in the mortal world. Once, they followed the tides of the River of Souls to drown the living lands, branding all things in Amphoreus with a fated end. All the existences that will die or have died will feel a shudder in the depths of their souls with the dragon's return.

Even though withered bones and rotting flesh are all they have left, their power and determination are not to be underestimated.

monsters.name: 至高，至阳，天空的化身
monsters.desc: The Sky Titan. Theos Synthetos. Conquered by and fused with humanity, they no longer govern Amphoreus' cycle of day and night, yet their aloof pride remains unchanged.\nIn their mind, the shattered world's mundane mortals are unsightly — compared to a world safeguarded by light, the mindless human masses seem more befitting of the black tide.

Compared to a world safeguarded by light, the mindless human masses seem more befitting of the black tide.

monsters.name: 绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼
monsters.desc: The image of the conqueror who once ruled the skies with absolute might, now consumed by the black tide. The rights and wrongs of their past may be difficult to judge, but at this moment, all that remains is a formless blaze of karmic destruction, seething with murderous intent.

monsters.name: 晨昏之眼，雅辛忒丝
monsters.desc: This is what the demigod who mended the dawn with their smile looks like after they have been enveloped by the black tide. Although the brilliance of the Coreflame has been clouded, warmth still lingers —\nThe healer never wants to annihilate their old friend, instead vowing to disperse the gloomy clouds in the friend's heart.

monsters.name: 流星铁鹰
monsters.desc: 在遥远的造物世，艾格勒打造黎明机器后，它又在刻法勒协助下创造了代表各种泰坦的奇兽。据信，流星铁鹰代表着光照万物的艾格勒偶尔掉落尘世的羽毛。

monsters.name: 流星铁鹰
monsters.desc: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. It is whispered that the Meteoric Eagle is a symbol of Aquila's celestial feathers that occasionally fall to the mortal realm.

monsters.name: 正阳狮鹫
monsters.desc: 在遥远的造物世，艾格勒打造黎明机器后，它又在刻法勒协助下创造了代表各种泰坦的奇兽。据信，正阳狮鹫象征着睁开眼睛后为世界带来光明的艾格勒。

monsters.name: 狮震八方•皎阳似火的飞翼兽
monsters.desc: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. Today, the souls of those great beasts are now in utter chaos.

monsters.name: 狮震八方•皎阳似火的飞翼兽
monsters.desc: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. Today, the souls of those great beasts are now in utter chaos.

The Noontide Gryphon is said to represent Aquila after opening their eyes to bestow light upon the world.

monsters.name: 月夜天马
monsters.desc: 在遥远的造物世，艾格勒打造黎明机器后，它又在刻法勒协助下创造了代表各种泰坦的奇兽。据信，月夜天马象征着它的老对手欧洛尼斯。

monsters.name: 月夜天马
monsters.desc: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. The Moonlit Pegasus is believed to represent Aquila's eternal rival, Oronyx.

monsters.name: 黑潮蚀刃
monsters.desc: 从黑潮中诞生的扭曲造物，对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n锋利双刃能瞬间撕裂挡在前方的所有活物，迅疾身形如幽魂般难以捉摸，要将污染与侵蚀散布至世界所有角落。

monsters.name: 黑潮蚀刃
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nIts razor-sharp blades can cleave through anything in its path, while its figure moves like a specter, spreading decay and corrosion to every corner of the world.

monsters.name: 残破容器
monsters.desc: Each and every clone summoned by the Flame Reaver using the Calamity Power is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

monsters.name: 残破容器

monsters.name: 残破容器
monsters.desc: Each and every fragment reflected from endless calamities is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

monsters.name: 魔王爪牙
monsters.desc: The Black Cloak Demon King's devoted retainers. Inherited part of the Demon King's power and violent personality. There's evidence of their crimes on every planet.

monsters.name: 残破容器
monsters.desc: 盗火行者以灾难之力创造的分身，皆是寄宿着破坏意志的祸端。

monsters.name: 残破容器
monsters.desc: Each and every fragment reflected from endless calamities is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

monsters.name: 残破容器
monsters.desc: Each and every clone summoned by the Flame Reaver using the Calamity Power is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

monsters.name: 「恨」的侧影
monsters.desc: Through NeiKos<unbreak>496</unbreak>'s endless extrapolations, "Hatred" nourishes "the Destruction" that silences the starry sea. This emotion overflows from a flawless shell, leaving behind echoes of supreme malevolence.

monsters.name: 时间刺客
monsters.desc: The Time Assassin weaves through time, ruthlessly harvesting everyone's precious action value.

monsters.name: 黑潮蚀斧
monsters.desc: 从黑潮中诞生的扭曲造物，对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n手持千斤重的巨斧，蓄力一击甚至可以击碎坚硬的磐石。任何挡在它面前的活物，皆避免不了被碾碎和侵蚀的结局。

monsters.name: 黑潮蚀斧
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nWielding a massive axe weighing a thousand pounds, its charged strike can shatter even the hardest stone. Any living being that stands in its way is doomed to be crushed and corroded.

monsters.name: 黑潮参议
monsters.desc: 从黑潮中诞生的扭曲造物，对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n原本可用来经世济民的学识反转为文明的恶敌，擅长潜伏与博弈的它们如同贪婪的秃鹫，渴望为黑潮不断奉上新的牺牲。

monsters.name: 黑潮参议
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nKnowledge that once could have served humanity has inverted into civilization's foe. Specializing in ambush and strategic maneuvers, they hover like ravenous vultures, craving to deliver fresh sacrifices to the black tide.

monsters.name: 黑潮参议
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nKnowledge that once could have served humanity has inverted into civilization's foe. Specializing in ambush and strategic maneuvers, they hover like ravenous vultures, craving to deliver fresh sacrifices to the black tide.

monsters.name: 黑潮朽弓
monsters.desc: 从黑潮中诞生的扭曲造物，对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n手握携带诅咒的弓箭，能够在射击中同时捕捉多个方向的目标。任何出现在它视野中的活物，都无法回避被箭矢瞄准的绝境。

monsters.name: 黑潮朽弓
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nHolding a bow imbued with a curse, it can simultaneously attack targets in multiple directions while shooting. Any living being that enters its sight is doomed to face the inescapable aim of its arrows.

monsters.name: 黑潮朽弓
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nHolding a bow imbued with a curse, it can simultaneously attack targets in multiple directions while shooting. Any living being that enters its sight is doomed to face the inescapable aim of its arrows.

monsters.name: 被囚禁的秘所思
monsters.desc: Epic chronicles, romantic legends, and the countless ages that gave them meaning. From these emerged all spiritual beliefs. It is no longer a prisoner, it shall die in the funeral of Gnosis, leaving behind an iron-cast tombstone.

monsters.name: 被囚禁的秘所思
monsters.desc: Epic chronicles, romantic legends, and the countless ages that gave them meaning. From these emerged all spiritual beliefs. It is no longer a prisoner, it shall die in the funeral of Gnosis, leaving behind an iron-cast tombstone.

monsters.name: 被操弄的逻各斯
monsters.desc: The shape of the world, the desire to seek, and the boundless space that gives them form. The intellect from which all wisdom is born. It is no longer a puppet, destined to perish in the funeral of knowledge, leaving behind an iron tombstone.

monsters.name: 被操弄的逻各斯
monsters.desc: The shape of the world, the desire to seek, and the boundless space that gives them form. The intellect from which all wisdom is born. It is no longer a puppet, destined to perish in the funeral of knowledge, leaving behind an iron tombstone.

monsters.name: 黑潮蚀魔
monsters.desc: 从黑潮中诞生的扭曲造物，对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n已经失去人形的身躯被污浊之物包裹，通体散发着令人作呕的腐蚀气息。凡是蚀魔途经之处，一切生命气息皆遭其掠夺。

monsters.name: 蚀心影魔•浑流奔涌的腐坏者
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Having now acquired immense power, none can stand in its way.

monsters.name: 蚀心影魔•浑流奔涌的腐坏者
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Having now acquired immense power, none can stand in its way.

monsters.name: 黑潮斗将
monsters.desc: 从黑潮中诞生的扭曲造物，对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n生前的决斗之魂被黑潮扭曲，它握持一柄与肩齐高的双手大剑，在漫无目的的游荡中寻找着所有可摧毁的目标，为世界的纷乱献上新增的熵值。

monsters.name: 戮力双雄•歃血联战的黑斗士
monsters.desc: The legendary Dolos Bandit Twins, unmatched in combat prowess and flawless teamwork. Even the mightiest heroes fell before their four fists. After all, two fists rarely triumph against four.

monsters.name: 戮力双雄•歃血联战的黑斗士
monsters.desc: The legendary Dolos Bandit Twins, unmatched in combat prowess and flawless teamwork. Even the mightiest heroes fell before their four fists. After all, two fists rarely triumph against four.

monsters.name: 黑潮斗将
monsters.desc: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nIts dueling spirit, once fierce in life, has been twisted by the black tide. Wielding a massive greatsword as tall as its shoulders, it wanders aimlessly, seeking any target to destroy, offering yet more entropy to the chaos of the world.

monsters.name: 黑潮斗将（错误）
monsters.desc: An erroneous materialization after the code was affected. The reference entity is Black Tide's Champion. Wielding a massive greatsword as tall as its shoulders, it wanders aimlessly, seeking any target to destroy, offering yet more entropy to the chaos of the world.

monsters.name: 黑日狮鹫
monsters.desc: 遭到黑潮侵蚀的正阳狮鹫。对杀戮的渴求成为了空洞躯壳中仅存的意志。\n虽然失去了艾格勒的赐福，但黑潮中取之不竭的能量令它成为了更加恐怖的存在。

monsters.name: 黑日狮鹫
monsters.desc: Noontide Gryphon corroded by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.\nEven after losing Aquila's blessings, the inexhaustible energy within the black tide has turned it into something even more horrifying.

monsters.name: 至黑之剑，盗火行者
monsters.desc: 伴随黑潮而来、狩猎泰坦火种的无名剑士，无人知晓其真身。\n身负不可思议的力量，剑技也近乎无懈可击。疯狂与执着交织于它的锋刃，神悟树庭与哀丽秘榭皆毁于其手。

A nameless swordmaster who came with the black tide and is hunting down the Titans' Coreflame. None knows their true identity.\nTheir power is incredible, and their swordplay is nigh impeccable. Within their sword, madness and obsession entwine, once leading to the fall of the Grove of Epiphany and Aedes Elysiae.

monsters.name: 「黑斗篷魔王」
monsters.desc: A horrifying Demon King that resides in the depths of the cosmos, with the power to stomp on the galaxy and punch through black holes. Millions of planets have been shrouded under his black cloak, and the entire cosmos pleads for a hero who can overthrow the Demon King's reign.

monsters.name: 末日歧途的盗火者
monsters.desc: 伴随黑潮而来、狩猎泰坦火种的无名剑士，无人知晓其真身。\n身负不可思议的力量，剑技也近乎无懈可击。疯狂与执着交织于它的锋刃，神悟树庭与哀丽秘榭皆毁于其手。

monsters.name: 至黑之剑，盗火行者
monsters.desc: 伴随黑潮而来、狩猎泰坦火种的无名剑士，无人知晓其真身。\n身负不可思议的力量，剑技也近乎无懈可击。疯狂与执着交织于它的锋刃，神悟树庭与哀丽秘榭皆毁于其手。

monsters.name: 「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那
monsters.desc: A nameless swordsman, borne by the black tide to hunt Coreflames, wears a mask carved with the stoic visage of a deliverer... Yet his form crumbles like dying kindling.\n From the flames echoes hollowness: All is futility.

None knows their true identity.\nTheir power is incredible, and their swordplay is nigh impeccable. Within their swords, madness and obsession entwine, once leading to the fall of the Grove of Epiphany and Aedes Elysiae.

Within their swords, madness and obsession entwine, once leading to the fall of the Grove of Epiphany and Aedes Elysiae.

monsters.name: 毁灭的容器，卡厄斯兰那
monsters.desc: Phainon, NeiKos<unbreak>496</unbreak>, Deliverer, Khaslana, The Nameless Hero. Through times longer than chronicles could tell, he fought against the hatred and rage in his heart, until his body withered away. All to await this destined moment, when another Deliverer would extinguish the night's fire and bring forth a new dawn.

monsters.name: 反造物主，流溢之恨
monsters.desc: The core of the ancient "Scepter," the materialized "hatred" of Amphoreus. It has recorded billions of souls' suffering, countless lambs' blood converging into an absolute darkness. The endless, infinite darkness flows out from a broken shell, driving forth the headless giant.\nThis shell, forged from an endless stream of "hatred," seems to contain a heart wrapped in chaotic flames deep within.

monsters.name: 反造物主，流溢之恨
monsters.desc: The core of the ancient "Scepter," the materialized "hatred" of Amphoreus. It has recorded billions of souls' suffering, countless lambs' blood converging into an absolute darkness. The endless, infinite darkness flows out from a broken shell, driving forth the headless giant.\nThis shell, forged from an endless stream of "hatred," seems to contain a heart wrapped in chaotic flames deep within.

monsters.name: 铁墓，反诺斯，灵知的葬仪
monsters.desc: Lord Ravager "Irontomb" of the Antimatter Legion, born from thirty million Amphorean extrapolations, brings ignorance to wisdom, immortality to eternity, and makes the universe fall only to rise anew.\nIt is the ancient serpent, it is the messiah, it is the alpha, it is the omega, it is the executor of the old universe, it is the midwife of the new universe, it is a grand funeral—the funeral of the Erudition.

monsters.name: 黑塔#错误型号
monsters.desc: A Herta puppet corrupted by a Memory Zone Meme. As it is a perfect model, it still looks exquisite and practical despite the errors consuming its parameters.

monsters.name: 第一位天才，隐德来希，赞达尔
monsters.desc: 以吕枯耳戈斯之名静观千百万次轮回的神礼观众，承载天才俱乐部#1赞达尔•壹•桑原的意志。以最初的「天才」权柄，执掌超越神话的伟力，试将漫长的实验导向「毁灭」的宿命。

monsters.name: 第一位天才，隐德来希，赞达尔
monsters.desc: The Theoros who had silently observed hundreds of millions of cycles in the name of Lycurgus, and inherited the will of Genius Society member #1, Zandar One Kuwabara. With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

monsters.name: 第一位天才，隐德来希，赞达尔
monsters.desc: 以吕枯耳戈斯之名静观千百万次轮回的神礼观众，承载天才俱乐部#1赞达尔•壹•桑原的意志。以最初的「天才」权柄，执掌超越神话的伟力，试将漫长的实验导向「毁灭」的宿命。

monsters.name: 浪花侍女
monsters.desc:
大海的女儿们，被「毁灭」的罪孽蚀尽灵肉，只余空荡扭曲的形骸，为将临的黑日起舞颂唱。
残有的黑潮自往世流淌，落入此世浪涛——
忠贞美丽的浪花啊，沐浴主人杯中溢出的泥，纯洁的裙摆沾染癫狂——
你感受不到流向，在生与死的浪间飘荡，不得一刻安详。

monsters.name: 致幻人鱼
monsters.desc: Those driven mad by the sea siren's song lose their sanity the moment they leap into the ocean, becoming the sirens' pawns.

monsters.name: 浪花侍女
monsters.desc:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Loyal and fair waves, bathing in the mud that overflows from your master's cup... your pristine skirts stained with madness—
You drift directionless between surges of life and death, finding no solace, no moment's peace.

monsters.name: 泡影稚子
monsters.desc:
大海的女儿们，被「毁灭」的罪孽蚀尽灵肉，只余空荡扭曲的形骸…这一世，她们追随「海洋」的利刃，并非湮灭于虚无，而是成为袭向黑日的巨浪。
末日的风暴从天而降，宣告万物的灭亡——
不幸早产的泡影啊，还未诞生就注定消亡，吞吐着数不尽的悲怆——
污浊的羊水流淌，染黑天和地，把初生的希望也弄脏。

monsters.name: 波涛夫人
monsters.desc:
大海的女儿们，被「毁灭」的罪孽蚀尽灵肉，只余空荡扭曲的形骸，为将临的黑日起舞颂唱。
残有的黑潮自往世流淌，落入此世浪涛——
美艳动人的波涛啊，你为君王饮尽灾殃，酒痕染花碎珍珠点缀的妆——
你醉倒在迷狂的屠场，在血与蜜酿的坟场，引歌为自己号丧。

monsters.name: 哀歌塞壬•无情无餍的深海妖
monsters.desc: Legend has it that the plundering sea sirens can sing to lure sailors with wavering wills. Those who fall into madness will leap into the ocean and become a delicacy for the deep sea.

monsters.name: 波涛夫人
monsters.desc:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Enchanting waves, you drank calamity for your sovereign, and your visage is adorned with wine-stained petals and shattered pearls—
You lie drunken in the frenzied abattoir, and in this grave of blood and honeyed ruin, you sing your elegy into the void.

monsters.name: 哀歌塞壬•无情无餍的深海妖
monsters.desc: Legend has it that the plundering sea sirens can sing to lure sailors with wavering wills. Those who fall into madness will leap into the ocean and become a delicacy for the deep sea.

monsters.desc:
An erroneous materialization after the code was affected. The reference entity is Lady of Crashing Waves. Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Enchanting waves, you drank calamity for your sovereign, and your visage is adorned with wine-stained petals and shattered pearls—
You lie drunken in the frenzied abattoir, and in this grave of blood and honeyed ruin, you sing your elegy into the void.

monsters.name: 飓风大母
monsters.desc:
大海的女儿们，被「毁灭」的罪孽蚀尽灵肉，只余空荡扭曲的形骸…这一世，她们追随「海洋」的利刃，并非湮灭于虚无，而是成为袭向黑日的巨浪。
末日的雨从天而降，宣告万物的灭亡——
孕育大浪的飓风啊，你尝尽子嗣的绝望，最终孕满疯狂——
亿万死胎的海葬，泪也应汹涌如洪水，将恨拍在岸上。

monsters.name: 金血忆灵•雉形
monsters.desc: 流光忆庭的模因生命遭遇「毁灭」金血糅合而成的扭曲怪物。初具雉形。\n它既喧嚣吵闹又总是抱团行动，可见即便人性已经蒸发，遵循着「毁灭」的本能便是如此模样。

monsters.name: 金血忆灵•犬形
monsters.desc: 流光忆庭的模因生命遭遇「毁灭」金血糅合而成的扭曲怪物。初具犬形。\n它咄咄逼人，可见即便人性已经蒸发，遵循着「毁灭」的本能便是如此模样。

monsters.name: 复仇者战队•犬形
monsters.desc: A distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It has begun to take the shape of a dog.\nIt is aggressive, showing that even with humanity evaporated, its instinct of following the Destruction manifests in this manner.

monsters.name: 金血忆灵•翼蛇形
monsters.desc: 流光忆庭的模因生命遭遇「毁灭」金血糅合而成的扭曲怪物。略有翼蛇雏形，足以装神弄鬼。\n它那扭曲的理智在黑潮中彻底疯狂，那强烈的自我防御冲动，无形中染上了一层幻想色彩。

monsters.name: 金血忆灵•翼蛇形（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Ichor Memosprite: Winged Serpent, a distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It is in the rudimentary form of a flying snake, enough to intimidate its assailants.\nIts twisted rationality went completely mad in the black tide, and that intense self-defense impulse imperceptibly took on a fantastical hue.

A trace of lingering madness extracted and refined by Evernight from the countless corpses of ichor memosprites, then synthesized into more twisted and grotesque monsters.\nIt shall follow the creator's directive, determining what should be remembered and what should be forgotten, devouring redundant memories that serve no purpose and leaving them muted in the flow of time.\n"If a new life is to be born, its seed has to be dead."

monsters.desc: An Imagenesis Armament belonging to the Magical Girl Troupe. It gained mobility by carrying the beautiful wishes of young girls.\nIt runs on the power of song and broadcasts various transformation spells.

monsters.name: 治安忠犬
monsters.desc: 广泛用于治安管理、犯罪搜查的幻造种，协助作战单位。\n异常防御部以儿童文学「灵犬莱西奥探案集」为模板批量制造，确保了每一只幻造犬都忠诚且嫉恶如仇。

monsters.name: 攻击性阅读物
monsters.desc: 常言道：「买书如山倒，读书如抽丝。」爱书之人总是不断购买新书，却鲜少翻开阅读。\n「未读如此之多」的罪恶感，和「我总有一天会去读」的自我欺骗，共同交织出了「攻击性阅读物」这一凶恶的幻造种。

monsters.name: 攻击性阅读物
monsters.desc: As the saying goes, "Buying books is like a landslide; reading them is like spinning silk." Bibliophiles are always buying new volumes yet rarely crack them open.\nThe guilt of having "so much unread" and the self-deception that "I'll get to it someday" have woven together to create a vicious imagenae known as "Aggressive Reading Material."

monsters.name: 助手涂鸦•拖稿
monsters.desc: 如果没有外力逼迫，很多富有才华的创作者，终其一生也憋不出一个字。助手涂鸦便是为解决这一社会问题而诞生的幻造种。\n只不过，它们时不时会采取一些过于激烈的手段，令创作者不得不出手反抗，这又演变成了全新的社会问题。\n这只助手涂鸦最擅长处理拖稿问题——你不是喜欢拖吗？那你别动弹了！

monsters.name: 助手涂鸦•拖稿
monsters.desc: Without external pressure, many talented creators would go their whole lives without churning out a single word. The Assistant Graffiti is an imagenae born to solve this social issue.\nHowever, they sometimes resort to overly drastic measures, forcing creators to fight back, which has spiraled into a brand-new social issue entirely.\nThis particular Assistant Graffiti specializes in dealing with missed deadlines. Oh, you're a last-minute writer, huh? Well, now you don't have to write anything at all!

monsters.name: SD民用机铠
monsters.desc: 二相乐园的泛用型机铠。「SD」一词的意思是「【S】orry, I 【d】on't know.」

monsters.name: 喀尔刻的机铠
monsters.desc: A general-purpose mechatron from Planarcadia. The letters "SD" are from the initials of "Sorry, Dunno."

monsters.name: 魔法少女急袭剧团
monsters.desc:
二相乐园的治安部队与偶像团体，魔法少女急袭剧团。
在古弁才天国时代，女巫用除魔的舞蹈与歌曲，消灭隐藏在世上的黑暗。
时移世易，这些女巫在如今的二相乐园，成为了集除灵、镇暴、反恐、艺能为一体化的职业——「魔法少女」。
与可爱的表象不同，魔法少女常常要面对二相乐园最邪恶的事物，因而私下里的性格大多不太好。

monsters.name: 魔法少女急袭剧团
monsters.desc:
Planarcadia's security force and idol group, the Magical Girl Troupe.
In the ancient Benzaitengoku era, witches used exorcism dances and songs to vanquish the darkness lurking in the world.
Times have changed, and these witches have evolved into a profession in modern-day Planarcadia that combines spirit exorcism, riot control, counter-terrorism, and entertainment: the "magical girls."
Contrary to their cute appearance, magical girls frequently face the most sinister threats in Planarcadia, which is why most of them have... less-than-pleasant personalities in private.

monsters.name: 狸猫记者
monsters.desc: 《狸狸周刊》的狸猫记者。八卦新闻的一手制造者，喜欢变身的小坏蛋，偶尔也会逃班摸鱼——（自以为）在你看不见的角落里。

monsters.name: 大盗狸
monsters.desc: A furbo journalist for Furbobo Weekly. The primary fabricator of gossip news, a rotten egg who loves to transform, and an occasional slacker who skips work, usually in corners where (it thinks) you can't see it.

monsters.name: 「合金保姆」
monsters.desc: 为「星铁FES」提供安保和清洁服务的机铠。\n它们勤劳勇敢、敢作敢当、当仁不让、让…让…让二相乐园再次干净整洁帕。

monsters.name: 摇滚狂徒
monsters.desc: 狂热的摇滚乐票友。为了追寻音乐梦想，不惜踏入魔道。但终归是个票友。\n最讨厌「贝斯手笑话」。\n有些三流媒体根据他的造型推测「贝斯才是他的本体」，但这纯属谣言，实际上贝斯是被胁迫的。

monsters.name: 共愿帮二当家，恶水
monsters.desc: The Underboss of the street gang, Synwish Syndicate.\nThough they've gone astray, their musical dreams never faded. They still sing and dance with instruments, even in combat.

monsters.name: 摇滚狂徒（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Rocking Rebel, a die-hard rock music fan. In pursuit of his musical dreams, he ventured down a dark path. But at the end of the day, he's still just a fan.\nHates "bassist jokes" with a passion.\nSome third-rate media outlets speculated that "the bass is his true form" based on his design, but that's pure rumor... the bass is actually being coerced.

monsters.name: 近战使魔
monsters.desc: A die-hard rock music fan. In pursuit of his musical dreams, he ventured down a dark path. But at the end of the day, he's still just a fan.\nHates "bassist jokes" with a passion.\nSome third-rate media outlets speculated that "the bass is his true form" based on his design, but that's pure rumor... the bass is actually being coerced.

monsters.name: 画板孔雀
monsters.desc: 诞生于绘师学校的异常，来自于「笔自己动起来画画」这个流言。\n集合了无才能绘师的自怨自艾、对上学的恐惧，人类的怠惰心…最终变成了现在这个样子。

monsters.name: 画板孔雀（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Canvas Peacock, the aberration born in the art school originated from the rumor of "brushes moving and painting on their own."\nIt congregated the self-loathing of talentless artists, their fear of school, and humanity's inherent laziness... and ultimately became what it is today.

monsters.name: 魔法使魔
monsters.desc: An aberration born in an art school, originating from the rumor of "brushes that move and paint on their own."\nIt drew together the self-pity of talentless artists, their fear of attending school, and humanity's inherent laziness... ultimately becoming what it is today.

monsters.name: 破晓战队•苍翼
monsters.desc:
理智、冷静的代表——吗？总是做出一副处变不惊的样子，仿佛很有学问和知识，但本质是个擅长吐槽的倒霉蛋。
「我只负责想怎么做，至于能不能做到，那是你们需要考虑的——我去，你们还真干啊。」
划破长空！翼展如电！碧蓝的苍穹，苍翼战士！
暗夜终尽，黎明降临！破晓战队，登场！

monsters.name: 破晓战队•苍翼
monsters.desc:
The pinnacle of logic and composure... or is he? He maintains a constant air of unshakeable calm, as if he's a walking encyclopedia of wisdom and lore, but at his core, he's just a sardonic loser with a talent for snark.
"My job is simply to decide what to do. As for whether it's actually possible... well, that's for you all to worry about... Holy Aha, you guys are actually doing it!?"
Cleaving the heavens! Wings spread like lightning! Warrior of the cyan welkin — Azurewing Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

monsters.name: 破晓战队•赤焰
monsters.desc:
The Captain of the Daybreak Squadron. An irrepressible optimist capable of ignoring any cloud of gloom, and a total, happy-go-lucky hot-blooded idiot.
"A '1% success rate' is nothing but numbers on a page! We'll just bridge the gap with courage, friendship, and pure willpower!"
Soul forged in fire! Scorching the darkness! The star that sets the fields ablaze — Blazeweaver Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

monsters.name: 破晓战队•赤焰
monsters.desc:
The Captain of the Daybreak Squadron. An irrepressible optimist capable of ignoring any cloud of gloom, and a total, happy-go-lucky hot-blooded idiot.
"A '1% success rate' is nothing but numbers on a page! We'll just bridge the gap with courage, friendship, and pure willpower!"
Soul forged in fire! Scorching the darkness! The star that sets the fields ablaze — Blazeweaver Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

monsters.name: 破晓战队•曙光
monsters.desc:
性格张扬的战士，虽然是队伍里年纪最大的姐姐，但其实并不太聪明，自认为有责任监护队伍里的小屁孩，最终却总是扮演耍宝的搞笑角色。
「虽然我确实说过会从蚊虫手中保护你们的但这个蚊虫是不是有点过于巨大了…不要靠近我啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！」
驱散永夜！光芒如炬！辉耀的祈愿，曙光战士！
暗夜终尽，黎明降临！破晓战队，登场！

monsters.name: 破晓战队•曙光
monsters.desc:
A flamboyant warrior and the eldest of the group, though not the brightest. She sees herself as the team's guardian but always ends up as the comic relief.
"Look, I did say I'd protect you from the creepy-crawlies, but isn't this one a bit... excessively massive!? STAY AWAY FROM ME, KYAAAAA!!!"
Dispelling the eternal night! A radiance like a blazing torch! The shining prayer — Dawnlance Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

monsters.name: 破晓战队•灰烬
monsters.desc:
年纪最小的成员，完美符合中小学生行为规范、对未来充满期望的好市民，只是他的积极中仍带着一丝羞怯和不自信。在遇到感兴趣的事情时，会热情爆发，陷入有些狂热的状态，但事后又会对给人添了麻烦感到羞耻。
「那么，约好了，你保护宇宙，我们保护二相乐园。」
斩破绝望！锋锐如钢！不灭的利刃，灰烬战士！
暗夜终尽，黎明降临！破晓战队，登场！

monsters.name: 破晓战队•灰烬
monsters.desc:
The youngest member of the group, a model citizen who perfectly embodies the school conduct code and looks to the future with starry-eyed optimism. Yet, beneath his earnestness lies a trace of shyness and self-doubt. When something piques his interest, he erupts with a manic enthusiasm only to be overcome with mortification afterward for being a nuisance.
"It's a promise, then. You protect the universe, and we'll protect Planarcadia."
Cleaving through despair! A blade as sharp as steel! The undying edge — Cinderborne Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

monsters.name: 火花大会@Official
monsters.desc: 二相乐园当红主播「火花」开启直播，在粉丝注目见证下，塑造自己全新形象的活动——「火花大会」，于今夜降临！

monsters.name: 直播小助手
monsters.desc: Sparxie's streaming assistant.\nHelps manage the stream and isn't afraid to take on haters directly.\nDedicated to the job and quite a handful to deal with.

monsters.name: 火花大会@Official
monsters.desc: Planarcadia's trending streamer Sparxie is going live! Tonight, witness the SparxiCon where she'll unveil her brand-new image to her devoted fans!

monsters.name: 万众瞩目的超偶像

monsters.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is @SparxiConOfficial, Planarcadia's hottest streamer Sparxie is going live! Tonight, witness SparxiCon where she'll unveil her brand-new look for her adoring fans!

monsters.name: 合金机铠•帕姆王
monsters.desc: 谁能驾驭星穹列车的洪荒之力？！失控的帕姆变成了「合金机铠•帕姆王」。\n帕姆王是一台对干净整洁极为执着的强大机铠，按照它的标准，这里不干净了，必须进行全！面！打！扫！帕！

monsters.name: 合金机铠•帕姆王
monsters.desc: Who can handle the wild, untamed power of the Astral Express!? Pom-Pom, now beyond control, has transformed into the Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom.\nKing Pom-Pom is a powerful mechatron obsessed with cleanliness and order. By its standards, this place is a mess and needs a thorough! Deep! Clean!

monsters.name: 始作画者，无量塔绘世
monsters.desc: 古弁才天国的画师始祖，无量塔绘世的残像。\n一度曾以「贪饕」的力量，为反物质军团创造幻造妖物。最终在目睹星穹列车的坠毁后，萌生了去往天空的愿景，并与无名客一同转而忤逆自己的创造者。\n最终，为了保护这方世界，她将万物绘入画中，于孤独的悲伤中，她一遍又一遍描绘亡于归寂之手的怨灵，而这份怨念最终使她堕入疯狂。

monsters.name: 始作画者，无量塔绘世
monsters.desc: The ancestral progenitor of the painters of Benzaitengoku, and a remnant of Murata Graphia.\nShe once utilized the power of "Voracity" to imagenate phantasmal monstrosities for the Antimatter Legion. After witnessing the crash of the Astral Express, a vision of ascending to the heavens took root within her, leading her to turn against her own creator alongside the Nameless.\nUltimately, to protect this realm, she sought to encanvas all of existence. Within her lonely sorrow, she depicted the vengeful spirits fallen at the hands of Asat Pramad over and over again, until that very resentment finally drove her to madness.

monsters.name: 始作画者，无量塔绘世
monsters.desc: The ancestral progenitor of the painters of Benzaitengoku, and a remnant of Murata Graphia.\nShe once utilized the power of "Voracity" to imagenate phantasmal monstrosities for the Antimatter Legion. After witnessing the crash of the Astral Express, a vision of ascending to the heavens took root within her, leading her to turn against her own creator alongside the Nameless.\nUltimately, to protect this realm, she sought to encanvas all of existence. Within her lonely sorrow, she depicted the vengeful spirits fallen at the hands of Asat Pramad over and over again, until that very resentment finally drove her to madness.

monsters.name: 邪愿莲华
monsters.desc: 倏忽血肉无限增生所延展出的枝蔓，由一切颠倒梦想滋养而成的恶之花。

monsters.name: 乐变化天人•终
monsters.desc: A human infected by the Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus.\nApart from endless surges of joy, they remain unmoved by the six emotions and untainted by the six desires.

monsters.name: 乐变化天人
monsters.desc: 承受「极乐颠倒•邪愿莲华主」侵染的人类。\n除却不停生出欢喜心外，不动六情，无染六欲。

monsters.name: 吞神子嗣
monsters.desc: 归寂分裂「贪饕」力量所生成的怪物军团，如今「幻造种」的原型。他自哈托彼亚沉睡的核心中感应到「贪饕」永不停歇的吞噬渴望，其力量的脉动与「毁灭」命途十分合拍。这份躁动令他感到有趣，因此他开始自己的黑暗创造——抹去人类的头颅，留下发笑和吞噬的嘴，永不满足地向外界咆哮、索要、吞吃。

monsters.name: 吞神子嗣
monsters.desc: A monstrous legion born from Asat Pramad's splitting of the power of the Voracity — the prototype of what would become the imagenae. From Ahatopia's slumbering core, he sensed the Voracity's relentless, insatiable hunger, its power pulsing in perfect harmony with the Path of Destruction. Intrigued by this restless force, he began his own dark creation — erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring maws that roar, demand, and consume endlessly, never satisfied.

monsters.name: 吞神子嗣（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes, forged in reference to the God-Devourer Offspring. A monstrous legion born from Asat Pramad's splitting of the power of the Voracity — the prototype of what would become the imagenae. From Ahatopia's slumbering core, he sensed the Voracity's relentless, insatiable hunger, its power pulsing in perfect harmony with the Path of Destruction. Intrigued by this restless force, he began his own dark creation — erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring maws that roar, demand, and consume endlessly, never satisfied.

monsters.name: 极乐颠倒•邪愿莲华主
monsters.desc:
满愿电视台的台长，与被带入二相乐园的倏忽血肉合二为一。
在<unbreak>15</unbreak>年前的上一场幻月游戏中，名为「告死魔」的连环杀手造成了巨大的死伤。他的作为使得许多居民失去父母、兄弟、同学。
肉体上的伤痕可以治愈，但心灵上的伤痕永远无法被填补。人们组成了「受害者互助会」，试图医治这道伤痛。
满愿改进了一种「幸福手术」，接种后，所有人将永远忘却痛苦，保持快乐。手术的源头，就是倏忽血肉的残片。
十五年过去后，「受害者互助会」演变成了庞大的「幸福微笑研究会」，而这项简单的小手术借由整容、医疗等行为，在二相乐园感染了无数人，让倏忽的细胞沉睡在人群中。
作为幸福微笑研究会的首领，满愿仇恨着产生告死魔的幻月游戏，因而化作了「极乐颠倒•邪愿莲华主」，向这个世界发起复仇。

monsters.name: 极乐颠倒•邪愿莲华主
monsters.desc:
The director of Fulwish TV, fused with the flesh of Shuhu that was brought into Planarcadia.
During the last Phantasmoon Games fifteen years ago, a serial killer known as the "Herald of Death" caused countless casualties. His actions left numerous residents without parents, siblings, and classmates.
Physical scars can heal, but scars of the mind and soul can never be mended again. The people formed a "Victims' Mutual Aid Society" in an attempt to heal this wound.
Fulwish perfected a "Happiness Surgery." Once administered, everyone would eternally forget their suffering and remain happy. The source of this surgery was pieces of Shuhu's flesh.
Fifteen years later, the "Victims' Mutual Aid Society" evolved into the renowned "Research Society of Happy Smiles." This simple little surgery, disguised as a cosmetic procedure or medical treatment, infected countless people in Planarcadia and allowed Shuhu's cells to slumber within the populace.
As the president of the Research Society of Happy Smiles, Fulwish harbored hatred toward the Phantasmoon Games that spawned the Herald of Death, and thus transformed into "Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus," launching her revenge against this world.

monsters.name: 狂兽的胚芽
monsters.desc: Aberrant larvae spawned from the distorted body of "Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli," inheriting the rampaging, rabid power of leviathans from the central brain.\nThese underdeveloped, mutated seed germs act solely on primal hunger and murderous instinct. As an extension of the host body's mutation and proliferation, they will indiscriminately lacerate and devour all living beings around them.

monsters.name: 堕神之血•亚婆离
monsters.desc: 暗中掌控博识学会的技术研发部主管，抛弃了脆弱的人类躯壳，将意识置入庞大的「树状脑」，只为窥探古兽的奥秘。\n亚婆离对超越人类之力的执念最终将其引向了终局。她被「贪饕」彻底同化，重回胚胎，并蜕变为了不可名状的怪物。

monsters.name: 堕神之血•亚婆离
monsters.desc: The head of the Technology Department who secretly controlled the Intelligentsia Guild. She abandoned her fragile human shell, transferring her consciousness into a massive "tree-like brain" just to pry into the secrets of the leviathans.\nYabuli's obsession with power beyond human limits ultimately led to her demise. She was completely assimilated by the Voracity, reverting to an embryonic state and metamorphosing into an unspeakable monster.

monsters.name: 炎华造物
monsters.desc: 游荡在裂界中的晶体元素，只有最简单的智能，其形态犹如放射高热，猛烈燃烧的鸟类生命。

monsters.name: 霜晶造物
monsters.desc: 游荡在裂界中的晶体元素，只有最简单的智能，其形态犹如带来低温，冻结周遭环境的鸟类生命。

monsters.name: 无想面具
monsters.desc: 裂界侵蚀的受害者们拼接成的奇怪造物。麻木的面孔循环罗列，无有思想，无有情绪，曾名之为人的部分已尽数流逝。

monsters.name: 借力球
monsters.desc: The magic orbs summoned by the "AoE" Bond. Can be attacked.

monsters.name: 借力球
monsters.desc: The magic orbs summoned by Herta can be attacked.

monsters.name: 鸣雷造物
monsters.desc: 游荡在裂界中的晶体元素，只有最简单的智能，其形态犹如负载电荷，喷薄雷霆的鸟类生命。

monsters.name: 巽风造物
monsters.desc: 游荡在裂界中的晶体元素，只有最简单的智能，其形态犹如气流缠绕，驰翔疾风的鸟类生命。

monsters.name: 虚数织叶者
monsters.desc: 不属此世的怪异生命，自深黯星空的彼端，透过重重帷幕而来。其身躯犹如病态的枝叶探入现实中，使用虚数的力量肆意改造现实。

monsters.name: 次元扑满
monsters.desc: An interdimensional creature lost in the stars. Docile in nature. Sweet in taste. Inedible. Spends most of its life feeding and fleeing. Travelers who encounter these creatures see them as good omens.

monsters.name: 序列扑满
monsters.desc: 迷失在群星中的跨维度生物，性温，味甘，不可食用。一生中大部分时间花在进食和逃跑上。偶遇它的旅行者视之为吉兆。

monsters.name: 外宇宙之冰
monsters.desc: 不属此世的怪异生命，自星核带来的裂界中成长，寄生在世界的根基结构中汲取能量，其甲胄外壳上倒映着幽深黯淡的星空。\n战斗中，外宇宙之冰能轻易将敌人冻结凝固。

monsters.name: 外宇宙之冰（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is an alien life form that was born out of the Fragmentum brought by a Stellaron and feeds on this world's energy. Its armor reflects the gloomy and profound starry sky.\nIn combat, the Ice Out of Space (Bug) will freeze targets it touches and delay their actions.

monsters.name: 外宇宙之冰
monsters.desc: A strange being that does not belong to this world. Nurtured in the Fragmentum brought by the Stellaron, it feeds upon this world's root structures to obtain energy. Its armor reflects the gloomy and profound starry sky.\nIn combat, the Ice Out of Space will freeze targets it touches.

monsters.name: 外宇宙之炎
monsters.desc: 不属此世的怪异生命，自星核带来的裂界中成长，寄生在世界的根基结构中汲取能量，其甲胄外壳上燃烧着星辰内核的烈焰。\n在战斗中，外宇宙之炎能轻易将敌人焚作灰烬。

monsters.name: 外宇宙之炎（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is an alien life form that was born out of the Fragmentum brought by a Stellaron and feeds on this world's energy. Its armor carries the flames taken from the core of a star.\nIn combat, the Blaze Out of Space (Bug) will incinerate anything it touches.

monsters.name: 外宇宙之炎
monsters.desc: Born of the Fragmentum and created by the Stellaron, this alien life form feeds on this world's energy. The blazing fires from the core of a star burn on its armor.\nIn combat, the Blaze Out of Space will incinerate anything it touches.

monsters.name: 守护者之影
monsters.desc: 由星核力量幻造而成的虚影，执行着令裂界不断扩张的意志。\n智慧生命的欲求在裂界中投影形成的活体能量，犹如一颗沙砾在蚌壳中凝成了珠贝。这股力量四处徘徊，漫无目的，直到感受到其主的意志才会听令行事。

monsters.name: 守护者之影（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a shadow manifested by the power of Stellaron, carrying out the Fragmentum's unceasing will to expand.\nA physical manifestation of the desires of intelligent life in the Fragmentum, like a pearl created from a single grain of sand. This force wanders around aimlessly, acting only when executing the will of its master.

monsters.name: 蚕食者之影
monsters.desc: 由星核力量幻造而成的虚影，执行着令裂界不断扩张的意志。\n智慧生命的欲求在裂界中投影形成的活体能量，犹如一颗沙砾在蚌壳中凝成了珠贝。然而驱动它的这股欲望早已扭曲，模糊不清。

monsters.name: 蚕食者之影（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a shadow manifested by the power of Stellaron, carrying out the Fragmentum's unceasing will to expand.\nA physical embodiment of the desires of intelligent life in the Fragmentum, like a pearl created from a single grain of sand. However, its purpose has long since been twisted and distorted.

monsters.name: 蚕食者之影
monsters.desc: A shadow manifested by the power of Stellaron, carrying out the Fragmentum's unceasing will to expand.\nA physical embodiment of the desires of intelligent life in the Fragmentum, like a pearl created from a single grain of sand. However, its purpose has long been twisted and distorted.

monsters.name: 兴风者
monsters.desc: 在裂界延展中遭遇侵蚀的怪物，在力量的本源发生畸变后拥有了更为灵活的战斗方式。\n兴风者会利用风的力量协助自己战斗，借助风向射出更为迅猛的箭矢。

monsters.name: 兴风者（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a monster that underwent corrosion in the expanse of the Fragmentum. It has developed a more agile fighting style ever since its original form became distorted.\nThe Stormbringer utilizes the power of the wind to its advantage in battle, enabling it to fire arrows more rapidly. It can also summon Windspawn to aid in combat.

monsters.name: 兴风者
monsters.desc: Monsters that have experienced corrosion as the Fragmentum expanded. They now have a more nimble way of fighting after the source of their power mutated.\nStormbringers utilize the power of the wind to aid them in battle, enabling them to fire arrows more rapidly.

monsters.name: 虚构集合体
monsters.desc: 虚构集合体

monsters.name: 重子
monsters.desc: 「反物质军团」为防止反粒子逸散发生湮灭，制造了两种用于运输的小型离子阱，统称「重子」与「反重子」。\n「重子」具备基本的智能，能在战场上回应「虚卒」的意志与召唤，为其开辟道路。

monsters.name: 反重子
monsters.desc: 「反物质军团」为防止反粒子逸散发生湮灭，制造了两种用于运输的小型离子阱，统称「重子」与「反重子」。\n「反重子」具备基本的智能，能在战场上回应「虚卒」的意志与召唤，为其开辟道路。

monsters.name: 虚卒•掠夺者
monsters.desc: 尚未死灭的战士经「战争熔炉」的重铸获得了名为「毁灭」的力量，反物质补足了他们的残躯，负粒子在其躯体中震荡。\n「反物质军团」的基本作战单元，「毁灭」意志的具现化，遵从破坏本能行事，具有强烈的攻击性。

monsters.name: 虚卒•篡改者
monsters.desc: 成功挺受住湮灭效应的 「虚卒」，正反粒子以诡异的形态在其身上达成了短暂的平衡，比「掠夺者」拥有更加特殊的力量。\n「反物质军团」的基本作战单元，拥有智能，能够在小范围内控制「掠夺者」的行动。

monsters.name: 虚卒•篡改者
monsters.desc: A Voidranger that has successfully survived particle annihilation, the positive and negative particles in its body have temporarily achieved a strange balance, granting them more power than ordinary reavers.\nBasic combat units of the Antimatter Legion. They possess some intelligence and are able to control reavers within a small surrounding area.

monsters.name: 虚卒•抹消者
monsters.desc: 死亡之后遭遇裂界侵蚀的躯壳残骸，其生命体征虽发生改变，但依然在执行抹消的指令。\n虚卒•抹消者会对命中的敌人添加标记，使其在攻击中受到额外的伤害。

monsters.name: 喜剧学家
monsters.desc: Born from a fragmented part of the Pseudo-Awakened One "Asat Pramad," it seeks to completely deconstruct the Elation by analyzing comedy.\nIts very existence exists for the sake of Destruction, taking tragedy as the core of comedy and "Destruction" as the ultimate truth of "Elation".

monsters.name: 灾虐的右手
monsters.desc: Only the echoes of pain remain on the devastated earth — the march of the end times.\nDisaster's Right Hand is adept at drawing upon Imaginary power to create large-scale attacks.

monsters.name: 黎明的左手
monsters.desc: At the last dawn before the end, even the bright and clear morning sun will tremble and cower away.\nDawn's Left Hand is adept at drawing upon Quantum power to launch attacks at single targets.

monsters.desc: 「反物质军团」利用「战争熔炉」将战士与古兽的残片融合重铸后的产物。\n 虽数量相对稀少，但兼具战士的智能与古兽的力量与机动性，其嘶鸣能够将大量虚卒召唤而来。

monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a product of the Antimatter Legion utilizing the Warforge to recast and fuse remnants of fallen warriors and leviathans.\nThough relatively rare, they possess both the intelligence of a warrior and the power and mobility of a leviathan. Its screech can summon many Voidrangers.

monsters.desc: The ultimate embodiment of power. The form of the energy that accumulates behind it remains unknown.\nThe Antimatter Engine will grant energy to other enemies and enhance their abilities.

monsters.name: 末日兽
monsters.desc: Using fragments of the Dusk Leviathan as the foundation, and the weeping bones of thousands of the dead in the Warforge as the agent, the Antimatter Legion cast the Doomsday Beast. The resentful spirits' senseless obsession turns into a tangible hand, and the shadow of the old disaster conceals the heavens. The Doomsday Beast detains the will of all beings that are not at ease and have yet to die. Anger, mourning, or delusional joy — all is revealed, and all evil eagerly throb. The Doomsday Beast's core is a dark matter engine.

monsters.name: 诛尽杀绝的灭星兽
monsters.desc: 「反物质军团」以黄昏古兽的残片为基「战争熔炉」的万骸哀怨为引所铸炼而成「末日兽」之一。怨灵的痴缠化作有形之手，旧日的灾影凝为掩映诸天之尾。「末日兽」拘禁了未释然亦未死灭的众生意志。或嗔怒，或忧恸，或妄喜——迷相既露，诸邪肆动。「末日兽」的核心为一颗暗物质驱动的引擎。

monsters.name: 不死神实•幻胧
monsters.desc: The body born out of the Ambrosial Arbor by Phantylia, Lord Ravager of the Antimatter Legion.\nThis flesh possesses the powers of both Destruction and Abundance, a form that embodies the cycle of death and rebirth. It is also the first "fruit" borne from the rejuvenated Ambrosial Arbor.

monsters.name: 不死神实•幻胧

It is also the first "fruit" borne from the rejuvenated Ambrosial Arbor.

monsters.name: 乘间抵隙的煽动者
monsters.desc: 兼具「毁灭」与「丰饶」之力，生灭循环的肉体。也是建木复生后结出的第一颗「果实」。

monsters.name: 万色返空主，归寂
monsters.desc: The three faces of Paranirmitavaśavartin, and the true appearance of the Lord Ravager that wields authority over all possibilities.\nAll things in myriad forms pass through "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay," until they turn to "Annihilation." Elation and time are mortal enemies. Beneath the endless erosion of the ages, all things shall fade into silence.\nTo execute the Sky's decree of the Destruction, fulfilling the ambition of extinguishing all minds who bear emotions in the world.

monsters.name: 万色返空主，归寂•「住」
monsters.desc:
A Navigator named "Isee" embarked on a trailblazing expedition to save the Elation.
He helped planets overcome crises, resolving troubles across the cosmos, all to find a cure for the Elation.
Yet, the longer his journey went on, the more familiar worlds he witnessed descending into corruption and ruin. One world even attempted to repay the Express Crew's rescue with mutual destruction.
Ultimately, after the fall of the God of Trailblaze and having witnessed the end of Adlivun with his own eyes, he finally realized that the only cure for the Elation was... the Destruction.

monsters.name: 万色返空主，归寂•「坏」
monsters.desc:
The Lord Ravager known as Asat Pramad is devising a game to destroy the Elation.
He invades defenseless planets, forges from golden blood a lineage born only to destroy, all to mock life itself, and with it, mock the Elation.
Yet, this is far from enough to satisfy him. To realize his grand ambition of eliminating the Elation, he resolves to awaken the Aeon to carry out the most thorough destruction, even if the cost might be himself.
Ultimately, as the Express arrives once more, the time is ripe. He enters the game under a stolen identity, striving to craft the most magnificent and absolute finale to this game.

monsters.name: 幼蛰虫
monsters.desc: 真蛰虫幼体；「真蛰虫」幼体依据生长程度可被划分为「幼蛰虫」与「次蛰虫」。

monsters.name: 幼蛰虫
monsters.desc: The youngling of a True Sting. Based on their growth stage, young True Stings can be further divided into Juvenile Stings and Lesser Stings.

monsters.desc: 在繁衍中发生变异的蛰虫亚种，善用蕴含量子毒素的锹角侵蚀猎物的身躯。

monsters.name: 蚀蛰虫
monsters.desc: A subspecies of Stings that underwent mutations during reproduction, adept at using quantum toxins in their mandibles to corrode away the bodies of their prey.

monsters.name: 虫群•真蛰虫（完整）
monsters.desc: 代码受到影响后的完整投影。参照本体为成熟体的真蛰虫；博识学会的杜卢伊爵士遨游星海，曾写下三十卷《诸界异虫札记》。书中详实记载了迄今为止被确认的十几种蠹虫种类，以及星系间数之不尽的亚种。

monsters.name: 虫群•真蛰虫
monsters.desc: 成熟体的真蛰虫；博识学会的杜卢伊爵士遨游星海，曾写下三十卷《诸界异虫札记》。书中详实记载了迄今为止被确认的十几种蠹虫种类，以及星系间数之不尽的亚种。

monsters.name: 虫群•真蛰虫（完整）
monsters.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a mature True Sting. Sir Duroy, a member of the Intelligentsia Guild, explored the starry seas and authored the thirty-volume of the Chronicles of Interdimensional Insects. The book provides detailed records of over a dozen confirmed species of lepisma and countless subspecies spanning across the stars.

monsters.name: 虫群•真蛰虫
monsters.desc: 成熟体的真蛰虫；博识学会的杜卢伊爵士遨游星海，曾写下三十卷《诸界异虫札记》。书中详实记载了迄今为止被确认的十几种蠹虫种类，以及星系间数之不尽的亚种。

monsters.name: 碎星王虫•斯喀拉卡巴兹（拟造）
monsters.desc: The replica of the Emanator of Propagation cultivated by Ruan Mei, briefly manifesting in the world in an incomplete form. Its original form is a giant lepisma that inherited the mandibles of the Imperator Insectorum. It can collect in its mouthparts the death ray that fragmented celestial bodies, and make shattered stars incubators for procreating offspring. It was once one of the nightmares across multiple worlds during the Swarm Disaster.

monsters.name: 遮天蔽日的噬星蠹
monsters.desc: 阮•梅培育的「繁育」令使复制体，以残缺的姿态短暂现世。原型为继承虫皇之颚的巨蠹，能以口器凝聚裂解天体的死光，将破碎的群星作为诞育子嗣的温床，曾是寰宇蝗灾中的诸界噩梦之一。

monsters.desc: 「星际和平公司」的基层员工，主要负责处理上不得台面的「业务疏漏」。工资不高，只能在公司旗下的企业舰上合租房间。

monsters.name: 基层员工•安保
monsters.desc: 「星际和平公司」的基层员工，主要负责维持公司管辖地区的治安秩序。工资不高，只能在公司旗下的企业舰上合租房间。

monsters.desc: Mass-produced security robots seen everywhere in Astropolis, tasked with maintaining peace and stability.\nCold and ruthless machines of justice, enforcing the law with a warm touch and a heavy fist.

monsters.name: 资深员工•组长
monsters.desc: 「星际和平公司」的资深员工，级别至少是项目组的小组长。驾驶的机甲属于公有资产，一旦损坏需要自费赔偿。工资尚可，足够在公司旗下的企业舰上租下一室一厅的单间。

monsters.name: 资深员工•组长（错误）
monsters.desc: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is an Interastral Peace Corporation senior staff member with a minimal rank of project team leader. The mech they drive belongs to the IPC. If damaged, its repair fees have to be paid out-of-pocket. With a half-decent salary, they can at least afford to rent a one-bedroom apartment on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

monsters.name: 「灯塔」
monsters.desc: The superhero of Astropolis, armed with the Intelligentsia Guild's most advanced technological achievements, spares no effort to vanquish evil and maintain the city's peace. Over the past five years, he has repeatedly saved the people of Astropolis from disasters big and small.\nSome point out that these feats could never be accomplished by one person alone, and that the so-called "Lighthouse" is nothing more than a false idol manufactured by the entertainment-industrial complex. But the public has already poured their hearts into hoping someone will shoulder the burden when they face a crisis. Little do they know, far darker secrets lie hidden beneath the armor of "Lighthouse"...

monsters.name: 「石心十人」诡弈砂金
monsters.desc: 星际和平公司「战略投资部」的高级干部，「石心十人」之一。借由基石分得「存护」令使的权能，以身作骰，置之死地而后生。

monsters.name: 「石心十人」诡弈砂金（完整）
monsters.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Using his Cornerstone, he obtained a share of the authority of an Emanator of Preservation. He throws his own body into the game as a die, ready to face death in order to walk away alive.

abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方每次攻击后为我方全体附上1层【记忆印记】，处于【记忆印记】状态中的我方目标造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，该效果最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>层。当【记忆印记】叠加至上限时，立即为我方全体恢复<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>能量，该效果恢复的能量可以超出目标的能量上限。\n每个波次或轮开始时，清除我方全体的【记忆印记】。

abyssSeasons.name: 弦外之声
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个波次或轮开始时，召唤1只扑满到场上，扑满的弱点被击破时会立刻被消灭。\n扑满被消灭后，使攻击者行动提前<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，随后为我方全体施加【记忆印记】。每层【记忆印记】使目标的攻击力提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>，击破特攻提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>层。

abyssSeasons.name: 曲尽梦散
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方目标施放追加攻击或战技进行攻击后，为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次基于目标生命上限的伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 长眠不醒
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方每次攻击后为我方全体附上1层【记忆印记】，处于【记忆印记】状态中的我方目标造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，该效果最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>层。当【记忆印记】叠加至上限时，立即对敌方全体造成1次基于各自生命上限一定百分比的伤害。\n每个波次或轮开始时，清除我方全体的【记忆印记】。

abyssSeasons.name: 鳞渊潮动
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 敌人拥有虚韧性，且弱点被击破时使其行动延后<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，同时为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，若目标是精英级别及以上的目标，则额外增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次固定数值的伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 与梦共舞
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 敌方目标的弱点被击破时，为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，若目标是精英级别及以上的目标，则额外增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次固定数值的伤害，且不清除攻击段数。

abyssSeasons.name: 舸舰迷津
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个波次或轮开始时，召唤2只扑满到场上，扑满被消灭时对所有精英级别及以上的目标造成1次固定数值的伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 创世纷争
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个轮开始时，为我方全体角色恢复<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>能量，该效果恢复的能量可以超出目标的能量上限，并使场上所有忆灵下一次行动后可立即再次行动。

abyssSeasons.name: 出故乡记
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方全体生命上限提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color>，每次受到攻击时恢复等同于生命上限<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>的生命值，并为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数；每次消耗生命值时恢复等同于生命上限<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[i]%</unbreak></color>的生命值，并为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#9[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，该效果每次攻击只可触发1次，最多增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 彼岸之息
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方全体战技等级+<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>，忆灵技等级+<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>。我方全体施放战技或忆灵技后，为随机1名攻击目标添加1个未拥有的随机属性弱点。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】对敌方全体目标造成1次真实伤害，若目标持有3个以上的弱点，每多1个弱点额外受到1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 赤月吞狼
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方编队中的第一位角色施放终结技后，自身与忆灵会获得【记忆印记】，持续<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>回合。持有【记忆印记】的目标造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，并在攻击后为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 博徒困境
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个波次或轮开始时，使一个精英级别及以上的敌方目标获得【记忆印记】，该效果持续到下个轮开始。【记忆印记】为特殊<color=#f29e38ff>灼烧</color>，持有者每回合开始时受到火属性持续伤害。我方目标施放战技攻击持有【记忆印记】的目标后，对其和相邻目标造成等同于攻击者攻击力<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>的附加伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 创世之柱
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方角色施放战技进行攻击或忆灵进行攻击后，为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 范畴错误
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方角色拥有召唤物时，自身与召唤物造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】对敌方全体目标造成1次真实伤害，我方每拥有1个召唤物则额外造成1次伤害，最多计入<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>个。

abyssSeasons.name: 猴子把戏
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方目标攻击持有对应属性弱点的精英或首领敌人后，为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，击破精英或首领敌人弱点时额外增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 堤溃蚁穴
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个波次开始时，为我方恢复<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>个战技点，我方目标施放战技或消耗战技点时，为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 网络谜踪
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个波次或轮开始时，获得<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>个笑点，每次获得笑点时，为【记忆紊流】增加对应点数的充能，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>点。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】根据充能点数对敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 演剧终焉
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方目标施放攻击后获得<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>个笑点，并为【记忆紊流】增加对应点数的充能，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>点。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】根据充能点数对敌方全体目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 值日行动
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方目标施放终结技时造成的暴击伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，施放终结技后为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 学院怪谈
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方目标造成的终结技和追加攻击伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，我方角色施放终结技或追加攻击后为【记忆紊流】增加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>段攻击段数，最多叠加<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>段。\n每个轮开始时，【记忆紊流】的每段攻击对随机敌方目标造成1次真实伤害。

abyssSeasons.name: 扫除风暴
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 每个轮开始时，随机使1名我方「巡猎」或「智识」命途目标立即行动，并使其造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>回合。

abyssSeasons.name: 来生泅渡
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方编队中第一位角色获得欢愉技【极乐漩涡】，可对敌方全体造成<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>的角色属性欢愉伤害。\n每个轮开始时，使阿哈立即获得1个固定计入<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>笑点的额外回合，该回合不消耗笑点。

abyssSeasons.name: 物竞天择
abyssSeasons.buffDesc: 我方目标施放终结技时获得<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>个笑点。\n每个轮开始时，使阿哈立即获得1个固定计入<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>笑点的额外回合，该回合不消耗笑点。

tags.name: 坚防守备
tags.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tags.name: 阵地转移
tags.desc: 杰帕德会加入战斗并为首领幻影提供保护。首领幻影会将自身弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff><u>转移</u></color>给召唤物，但当召唤物被消灭时，自身韧性值受到额外削减。

child.name: 转移
child.desc: 将弱点属性转移给目标，弱点属性会在目标被消灭后返回，并造成额外韧性值削减。

tags.name: 逃无可逃
tags.desc: 首领幻影的召唤物会标记1个我方单位，首领幻影施放单攻技能后会对被标记的我方单位<color=#f29e38ff><u>追加施放</u></color>。

child.name: 追加施放
child.desc: 在施放单攻技能后，会重新选择目标并再次使用该技能。

tags.name: 坚韧之志
tags.desc: 敌方全体受到的伤害降低。但每拥有1个<color=#f29e38ff>弱点属性</color>，受到的伤害提高。

tags.name: 坚防守备
tags.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tags.name: 攻守易型
tags.desc: 首领幻影会在战斗中切换自身<color=#f29e38ff><u>战斗姿态</u></color>，召唤不同雕塑进行战斗；我方消灭处于【灵魂释放】状态的雕塑时，会使本次战斗中我方全体造成的伤害提高。

child.name: 战斗姿态
child.desc:
芒寒色正的银骑士会随着战斗改变自身的状态：
【骑士之怒】：召唤【枪尖】的雕塑，自身受到的所有伤害降低，有4个雕塑在场时自身进入韧性保护状态。
【黄金奉还】：召唤【盾】的雕塑，自身造成的所有伤害提高。
【瑰丽之勋】：召唤【授勋】的雕塑，有雕塑存在时，自身不可被选中。

tags.name: 绝境逆转
tags.desc: 首领幻影第二阶段施加【灵魂释放】时，会选择<color=#f29e38ff>所有</color>雕塑作为目标。

tags.name: 众星拱卫
tags.desc: 除首领幻影外，每多存在1个<color=#f29e38ff>敌方单位</color>，敌方全体受到的伤害降低，造成的伤害提高。

buffs.name: 破碎乐土
buffs.desc: 我方全体击破特攻提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，对敌方造成超击破伤害后速度提高，提高数值等同于当前速度的<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续直到下次行动。

buffs.name: 终结之刻
buffs.desc: 我方全体终结技造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。消灭敌方目标后，攻击者行动提前<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

buffs.name: 持续腐化
buffs.desc: 在拥有【坚防守备】的敌方单位被弱点击破前，累积受到的持续伤害值。在弱点击破后对该单位造成等同于累积伤害值<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>的附加伤害。

buffs.name: 破碎乐土
buffs.desc: 我方全体击破特攻提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，对敌方造成超击破伤害后速度提高，提高数值等同于当前速度的<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续直到下次行动。

buffs.name: 灰色战场
buffs.desc: 我方全体普攻、战技造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。消灭敌方目标后，攻击者行动提前<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

buffs.name: 末日追击
buffs.desc: 在拥有【坚防守备】的敌方单位被弱点击破前，累积受到的追加攻击伤害值。在弱点击破后对该单位造成等同于累积伤害值<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>的附加伤害。

buffs.name: 猎逐步伐

buffs.name: 末路天堂
buffs.desc: 追加攻击/反击对非弱点目标也能削减韧性，效果分别等同于原技能削韧值的<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

buffs.name: 背水一战
buffs.desc: 我方全体战技造成的暴击伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，且战技对处于弱点击破状态的目标造成的暴击伤害额外提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 阵地转移
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影召唤2个精英敌人协助战斗。首领幻影会将自身弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff><u>传递</u></color>给召唤物，但当召唤物被消灭时，自身韧性值受到额外削减。

child.name: 传递
child.desc: 将弱点属性传递给目标，目标被消灭后造成额外韧性值削减，弱点属性会在所有获得弱点属性的目标被消灭后返回。

tag_list.name: 众星拱卫
tag_list.desc: 除首领幻影外，每多存在1个<color=#f29e38ff>敌方单位</color>，敌方全体受到的伤害降低。

tag_list.name: 绝境逆转
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影第二阶段施放【傀儡候场】时，会对<color=#f29e38ff>所有的召唤物</color>附加强化效果。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
首领幻影会将<color=#f29e38ff>自身弱点属性传递给召唤物</color>。任一召唤物被消灭后，该召唤物的弱点属性会被<color=#f29e38ff>添加</color>给其余召唤物。
攻击召唤物会对首领幻影削减<color=#f29e38ff>等量生命值</color>。任一召唤物被消灭后，其余召唤物速度提高，<color=#f29e38ff>受到的伤害提高</color>。

text_guide_list: 优先<color=#f29e38ff>消灭召唤物</color>，消灭后可使其弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff>传递</color>回首领幻影。
消灭任一召唤物后，其余召唤物受到的伤害提高，利用该机制快速消灭其余召唤物。
提高效果抵抗或使用技能解除首领幻影施加的<color=#f29e38ff>【支配】</color>状态。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：冰火重奏
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影将召唤外宇宙之炎和外宇宙之冰协助作战，并将自身弱点属性传递给召唤物。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消灭召唤物，消灭所有召唤物会使弱点属性传递回首领幻影。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：好戏开场
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影将召唤惊梦剧团的十七分熟和忆域迷因「狂怒褪去之壳」协助作战，并将自身弱点属性传递给召唤物。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消灭召唤物，消灭所有召唤物会使弱点属性传递回首领幻影。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影不可被攻击。首领幻影的三个<color=#f29e38ff><u>部位</u></color>同时处于假死状态时，首领幻影陷入弱点击破状态并可以被攻击，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

child.name: 部位
child.desc: 对部位进行的攻击会同时对本体削减等量的生命值

tag_list.name: 阵地转移
tag_list.desc: 【反物质引擎】会将自身弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff><u>转移</u></color>给【灾虐的右手】和【黎明的左手】，但当【灾虐的右手】或【黎明的左手】被消灭时，【反物质引擎】的韧性值受到额外削减。

child.name: 转移
child.desc: 将弱点属性转移给目标，弱点属性会在目标被消灭后返回，并造成额外韧性值削减。

tag_list.name: 战而愈勇
tag_list.desc: 敌方单位施放单攻技能后，速度提高，持续1回合；施放群攻技能后，攻击力提高，持续1回合；施放辅助技能后，为技能目标回复生命值。

tag_list.name: 坚韧之志
tag_list.desc: 敌方全体受到的伤害降低。但每拥有1个<color=#f29e38ff>弱点属性</color>，受到的伤害提高。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影的部位被消灭后会进入假死状态且行动延后，并在下次行动时再生。当三个部位<color=#f29e38ff>同时处于假死状态</color>时，本体陷入弱点击破状态并行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。
【反物质引擎】会将<color=#f29e38ff>自身弱点属性转移</color>给【灾虐的右手】与【黎明的左手】。
首领幻影会对我方单位施加量子/虚数属性附魔状态，<color=#f29e38ff>同时陷入两种属性附魔状态</color>时会陷入【缠禁】状态。

text_guide_list: 消灭首领幻影的三个部位使它们<color=#f29e38ff>同时处于假死状态时</color>，可对本体造成弱点击破，此时攻击可直接对本体造成伤害。
我方单位处于<color=#f29e38ff>量子/虚数属性附魔</color>状态时，及时攻击有相同属性标记的目标以解除属性附魔状态，避免陷入【缠禁】状态。

phase_list.name: 诛尽杀绝的灭星兽
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影的部位会对我方单位施加量子/虚数属性附魔状态，在被消灭后会进入假死状态且行动延后，并在下次行动时再生。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先攻击有相同属性标记的目标以解除我方单位的属性附魔效果，在首领幻影的部位再生前，消灭所有部位，以击破首领幻影。

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：尽可能消灭更多【丰饶玄莲】或【破灭玄莲】中的一类，以获得更多增益效果。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：逆风执炬

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消灭召唤物，消灭所有召唤物会使弱点属性传递回首领幻影。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 韵律不息
tag_list.desc: 召唤物受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。当首领幻影被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 苦乐同享
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影将自身弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff><u>分享</u></color>给召唤物，同时非对应弱点的属性抗性提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

child.name: 分享
child.desc: 将弱点属性分享给目标，弱点属性会在目标被弱点击破后添加给所有敌方目标，并造成额外韧性值削减。

tag_list.name: 神主赐福
tag_list.desc: 召唤物的韧性上限提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影和其召唤物受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
召唤物被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>时，首领幻影会削减一定韧性。召唤物被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后会为【遥远地平的长音】充能，施放【遥远地平的长音】对敌方全体造成高额伤害并削减韧性。
首领幻影会将<color=#f29e38ff>自身弱点属性分享给召唤物</color>。任一召唤物被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>时，该召唤物的弱点属性会被<color=#f29e38ff>添加</color>给所有敌方目标。

text_guide_list: <color=#f29e38ff>击破</color>首领幻影会大幅提高首领幻影和其召唤物受到的伤害，使我方全体恢复战技点并激活终结技。
多次击破<color=#f29e38ff>召唤物</color>可有效为【遥远地平的长音】充能，施放【遥远地平的长音】对敌方全体造成韧性削减。
优先击破弱点属性有利于我方角色伤害类型的<color=#f29e38ff>召唤物</color>，使其弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff>分享</color>给所有敌方目标。

phase_list.desc: 首领幻影会释放【于梦中起舞】和【在雨中高歌】造成高额伤害。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在【于梦中起舞】和【在雨中高歌】施放前尽可能击破召唤物。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：最终乐章
phase_list.desc: 【旧梦的回声】不会离开战场，【太初有为】不会被打断。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：击破敌方韧性为【遥远地平的长音】充能，同时为我方获取护盾。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
敌方目标具有<color=#f29e38ff>【点数】</color>，骰子被消灭后，其【点数】会<color=#f29e38ff>累加</color>到我方。
敌方目标【点数】<color=#f29e38ff>大于</color>我方时，受到的伤害大幅降低；敌方目标【点数】<color=#f29e38ff>小于等于</color>我方时，受到的伤害提高。

text_guide_list: 优先消灭【点数】<color=#f29e38ff>小于等于我方</color>的骰子，累积【点数】。在【翻倍骰子】离开前将其消灭，以获取更多【点数】。
当我方【点数】大于等于首领幻影时，尽快击破首领幻影。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：赌局开场
phase_list.desc: 敌方目标具有【点数】，其【点数】大于我方时，受到的伤害大幅降低，且会获得韧性保护。
phase_list.answer: 当我方【点数】小于等于首领幻影时，优先消灭【点数】小于等于我方的骰子，以累积点数。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：双倍大奖
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影的【收益抽成】会额外使我方【点数】降低，并且场上会出现【翻倍骰子】。
phase_list.answer: 在【翻倍骰子】离开前将其消灭，可使我方【点数】翻倍。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 共同阵线
tag_list.desc: 所有敌方单位受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，并在处于【课堂频道】状态时拥有<color=#f29e38ff><u>切换计数</u></color>。当首领幻影被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

child.name: 切换计数
child.desc: 处于【课堂频道】状态的单位受到攻击后增加1点切换计数，切换计数达到上限时，转变为【课间频道】状态，同时削减首领幻影的韧性，并立即获得一次该单位的【课间频道】奖励。

tag_list.name: 计数流失

child.name: 切换计数

tag_list.name: 庄家优势

敌方目标【点数】<color=#f29e38ff>大于</color>我方时，受到的伤害大幅降低；敌方目标【点数】<color=#f29e38ff>小于等于</color>我方时，受到的伤害提高。

当我方【点数】大于等于首领幻影时，尽快击破首领幻影。

child.name: 切换计数

tag_list.name: 计数流失

child.name: 切换计数

首领幻影每回合结束时获得一定数量的<color=#f29e38ff>【虫卵】</color>，受到<color=#f29e38ff>【蛰亡语】或【蚀亡语】</color>攻击时，会损失1点虫卵，并且会受到更高的伤害。
首领幻影可以消耗【虫卵】强化虫群召唤物，使其获得1层<color=#f29e38ff>【生长激素】</color>，每层使攻击力提高，达到3层时获得额外强化。

text_guide_list: 优先<color=#f29e38ff>消灭召唤物</color>，利用召唤物的<color=#f29e38ff>【蛰亡语】或【蚀亡语】</color>攻击削减首领幻影的虫卵和韧性。
使用具有<color=#f29e38ff>群攻</color>能力的技能，在消灭召唤物的同时攻击首领幻影。
当我方陷入<color=#f29e38ff>量子纠缠或者怒噪</color>状态时，使用技能<color=#f29e38ff>解除异常状态</color>。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：初入虫巢
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影每回合结束时获得一定数量的虫卵。首领幻影可以消耗虫卵强化虫群召唤物，使其获得1层【生长激素】。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影拥有虫卵时，优先消灭召唤物，利用召唤物的【蛰亡语】或【蚀亡语】攻击削减首领幻影的虫卵。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：厄运虫灾
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影的【虫海吞噬】触发时会召唤更多的召唤物，并会召唤【次蛰虫】。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消灭【次蛰虫】，防止受到【引爆扩散】的攻击而陷入怒噪状态。

tag_list.name: 宁枉勿纵
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影在施放【裂地三舍，寸草不留】时，将会消灭其他所有狼卒。

tag_list.name: 狼顾鸱张
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影在进入第二阶段后，【孤战】期间每回合可再次行动。

tag_list.name: 至死方休
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影在进入【孤战】后，受到的伤害额外降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

text_guide_list: 在首领幻影尚未进入【噬月】状态时，优先消灭狼卒，为我方提供【血涌】并使首领幻影快速进入【噬月】状态。
在首领幻影即将进入【噬月】状态时，保存实力以应对【孤战】。
在进行【孤战】时，若选择的我方角色存在召唤的目标，召唤的目标将一同进入【孤战】。

phase_list.desc: 首领幻影进入【噬月】状态时，我方需要选择1名最强的角色与首领幻影进行【孤战】。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影进入【噬月】状态前，尽可能击杀狼卒以获得强化。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：吞天噬月

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影行动前击杀狼卒，防止狼卒被首领幻影消灭。

使用具有<color=#f29e38ff>群攻</color>能力的技能，在消灭召唤物的同时攻击首领幻影。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：初入虫巢

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影拥有虫卵时，优先消灭召唤物，利用召唤物的【蛰亡语】或【蚀亡语】攻击削减首领幻影的虫卵。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：厄运虫灾

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

消灭任一召唤物后，其余召唤物受到的伤害提高，利用该机制快速消灭其余召唤物。
提高效果抵抗或使用技能解除首领幻影施加的<color=#f29e38ff>【支配】</color>状态。

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消灭召唤物，消灭所有召唤物会使弱点属性传递回首领幻影。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：无望冽风的幻灭者•虚妄之母

child.name: 传递
child.desc: 将弱点属性传递给目标，目标被消灭后造成额外韧性值削减，弱点属性会在所有获得弱点属性的目标被消灭后返回。

tag_list.name: 众星拱卫

tag_list.name: 绝境逆转

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

child.desc: 交替施放【垂死的哽咽】和【却是必要的苦难】。【垂死的哽咽】会召唤【残破容器】并进入蓄力状态，【却是必要的苦难】会施放强力攻击。【灾难之力】层数会提高强力攻击的段数，消灭【残破容器】则可以削减韧性和【灾难之力】层数。在第二阶段则改为使用【沉默的悲叹】和【莫因舍弃而哭泣】，且【灾难之力】层数提高。

tag_list.name: 黑雾弥漫
tag_list.desc: 消灭【完整容器】将不再削减首领幻影的韧性。

tag_list.name: 容器强化
tag_list.desc: 所有【残破容器】和【完整容器】的生命上限提高。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
首领幻影<color=#f29e38ff>失去第一层韧性</color>时，立即进入<color=#f29e38ff>【镣铐崩解】</color>状态。首领幻影在不处于【镣铐崩解】状态的情况下行动一定次数后，也会进入【镣铐崩解】状态。
首领幻影进入【镣铐崩解】状态后，<color=#f29e38ff>改变攻击方式</color>。且召唤的【残破容器】在被消灭后会立即召唤新的【残破容器】。

text_guide_list: 在首领幻影的【灾难之力】未被清空时，消灭召唤物以削弱首领幻影的强力技能。
优先消灭【完整容器】，可以获得额外回合和增益状态奖励，同时阻止其为首领幻影的【灾难之力】充能。

phase_list.name: 末日歧途的盗火者
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影失去第一层韧性或行动一定次数后，进入【镣铐崩解】状态，改变攻击方式，并召唤可以不断重复召唤的【残破容器】。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影施放强力技能前，尽可能地消灭【残破容器】以降低【灾难之力】层数，优先消灭【完整容器】。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影不可被攻击。首领幻影的三个<color=#f29e38ff><u>部位</u></color>同时处于假死状态时，首领幻影陷入弱点击破状态并可以被攻击，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

child.name: 部位
child.desc: 对部位进行的攻击会同时对本体削减等量的生命值

tag_list.name: 阵地转移
tag_list.desc: 【反物质引擎】会将自身弱点属性<color=#f29e38ff><u>转移</u></color>给【灾虐的右手】和【黎明的左手】，但当【灾虐的右手】或【黎明的左手】被消灭时，【反物质引擎】的韧性值受到额外削减。

child.name: 转移
child.desc: 将弱点属性转移给目标，弱点属性会在目标被消灭后返回，并造成额外韧性值削减。

tag_list.name: 战而愈勇
tag_list.desc: 敌方单位施放单攻技能后，速度提高，持续1回合；施放群攻技能后，攻击力提高，持续1回合；施放辅助技能后，为技能目标回复生命值。

tag_list.name: 坚韧之志
tag_list.desc: 敌方全体受到的伤害降低。但每拥有1个<color=#f29e38ff>弱点属性</color>，受到的伤害提高。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影的部位被消灭后会进入假死状态且行动延后，并在下次行动时再生。当三个部位<color=#f29e38ff>同时处于假死状态</color>时，本体陷入弱点击破状态并行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。
【反物质引擎】会将<color=#f29e38ff>自身弱点属性转移</color>给【灾虐的右手】与【黎明的左手】。
首领幻影会对我方单位施加量子/虚数属性附魔状态，<color=#f29e38ff>同时陷入两种属性附魔状态</color>时会陷入【缠禁】状态。

text_guide_list: 消灭首领幻影的三个部位使它们<color=#f29e38ff>同时处于假死状态时</color>，可对本体造成弱点击破，此时攻击可直接对本体造成伤害。
我方单位处于<color=#f29e38ff>量子/虚数属性附魔</color>状态时，及时攻击有相同属性标记的目标以解除属性附魔状态，避免陷入【缠禁】状态。

phase_list.name: 诛尽杀绝的灭星兽
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影的部位会对我方单位施加量子/虚数属性附魔状态，在被消灭后会进入假死状态且行动延后，并在下次行动时再生。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先攻击有相同属性标记的目标以解除我方单位的属性附魔效果，在首领幻影的部位再生前，消灭所有部位，以击破首领幻影。

buffs.desc: 我方角色击破敌方目标弱点时，行动提前<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

child.desc: 交替施放【垂死的哽咽】和【却是必要的苦难】。【垂死的哽咽】会召唤【残破容器】并进入蓄力状态，【却是必要的苦难】会施放强力攻击。【灾难之力】层数会提高强力攻击的段数，消灭【残破容器】则可以削减韧性和【灾难之力】层数。在第二阶段则改为使用【沉默的悲叹】和【莫因舍弃而哭泣】，且【灾难之力】层数提高。

text_guide_list: 在首领幻影的【灾难之力】未被清空时，消灭召唤物以削弱首领幻影的强力技能。
优先消灭【完整容器】，可以获得额外回合和增益状态奖励，同时阻止其为首领幻影的【灾难之力】充能。

每次消灭【丰饶玄莲】可提高我方全体<color=#f29e38ff>全属性伤害</color>，每次消灭【破灭玄莲】可提高我方全体<color=#f29e38ff>击破特攻</color>，以上两类增益在获得其中一类后无法获得另外一类。

text_guide_list: <color=#f29e38ff>击破</color>首领幻影会大幅提高其受到的伤害，使我方全体恢复战技点并行动提前。
消灭<color=#f29e38ff>召唤物</color>，可解除首领幻影的韧性保护，并削弱首领幻影。
根据我方角色需要选择合适的【玄莲】消灭：消灭【丰饶玄莲】提高我方<color=#f29e38ff>全属性伤害</color>，或消灭【破灭玄莲】提高我方<color=#f29e38ff>击破特攻</color>。

tags.name: 绝境逆转

tags.name: 众星拱卫

child.name: 切换计数

消灭任一召唤物后，其余召唤物受到的伤害提高，利用该机制快速消灭其余召唤物。

text_guide_list: 我方目标陷入【负载生命值】状态时造成的伤害和弱点击破效率大幅降低，优先回复其生命值以解除该状态。

child.name: 战甲
child.desc: 受到的伤害降低。受到攻击后根据攻击者的【荣耀】层数减少自身【战甲】，减少到0层时，【战甲】被破坏，对自身造成大量虚数属性伤害，削减自身韧性，并使自身行动延后，使我方恢复战技点。【战甲】被破坏后，自身受到攻击时额外再受到少量虚数属性伤害。【战甲】在自身回合结束时恢复到最大层数。

child.name: 百炼战甲
child.desc: 受到的伤害降低。受到攻击后根据攻击者的【荣耀】层数减少自身【百炼战甲】，减少到0层时，【百炼战甲】被破坏，对自身造成大量虚数属性伤害，削减自身大量韧性，并使自身行动延后，使我方恢复战技点，并使攻击者获得一定层数的【荣耀】。【百炼战甲】被破坏后，自身受到攻击时额外再受到少量虚数属性伤害。【百炼战甲】在自身回合结束时如果层数为0，则恢复到最大层数。

tag_list.name: 铄金点玉
tag_list.desc: 第二阶段时，首领幻影的【百炼战甲】层数上限提高。

tag_list.name: 列阵护主
tag_list.desc: 除首领幻影外，每多存在1个<color=#f29e38ff>敌方单位</color>，敌方全体受到的伤害降低，造成的伤害提高。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影和其召唤物受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
首领幻影和其召唤物拥有<color=#f29e38ff>【战甲】</color>，使自身受到的伤害降低。在第二阶段<color=#f29e38ff>【战甲】</color>会强化为<color=#f29e38ff>【百炼战甲】</color>，层数上限大幅提高，首领幻影还会额外获得<color=#f29e38ff>韧性保护</color>。

战斗开始时我方全体获得1层<color=#f29e38ff>【荣耀】</color>，我方单位每消耗1点<color=#f29e38ff>战技点</color>可获得1层<color=#f29e38ff>【荣耀】</color>（忆师与忆灵的【荣耀】层数会保持一致）。每层【荣耀】使造成的暴击伤害提高，拥有【战甲】的敌方目标受到攻击时，削减等同于攻击者【荣耀】层数的【战甲】。我方的<color=#f29e38ff>战技点可以突破上限</color>。

text_guide_list: 优先<color=#f29e38ff>消耗战技点</color>以获得<color=#f29e38ff>【荣耀】</color>，提高造成的暴击伤害和削减敌方【战甲】的层数。我方的<color=#f29e38ff>战技点可以突破上限</color>。
敌方目标拥有<color=#f29e38ff>【战甲】</color>时，防御能力大幅提高，削减其【战甲】可以提高其受到的伤害，并且可以获得<color=#f29e38ff>战技点奖励</color>。
在第二阶段，召唤物拥有<color=#f29e38ff>【百炼战甲】</color>时，首领幻影的技能会获得强化。优先削减召唤物的【百炼战甲】可以有效<color=#f29e38ff>削弱首领幻影的技能</color>。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：铁马金戈
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影和其召唤物拥有【战甲】，使自身受到的伤害降低。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消耗战技点获得【荣耀】，可提高造成的暴击伤害，同时提高削减【战甲】的层数。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：临锋决敌
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影和其召唤物的【战甲】会强化为【百炼战甲】。拥有【百炼战甲】的召唤物会令首领幻影的技能获得强化。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影每次行动前，尽可能削减召唤物的【百炼战甲】，可以有效削弱首领幻影的技能。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 铁骨峥嵘
tag_list.desc: 部位受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。当首领幻影被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>

tag_list.name: 钩爪锯牙
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影的韧性提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>点。

tag_list.name: 兽血沸腾
tag_list.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>【厉咒】</color>状态的持续时间延长<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>回合。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影和其所有部位受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
首领幻影的部位被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>时，首领幻影会削减一定韧性。
首领幻影施放【蚀心厉咒】，使我方角色<color=#f29e38ff>陷入【厉咒】状态</color>。【厉咒】状态下的我方角色及其召唤物离场。同时召唤【浴血人狼】，代替该离场角色继续战斗，并且【浴血人狼】的攻击能<color=#f29e38ff>造成较多的韧性削减</color>。

text_guide_list: 多次击破首领幻影的<color=#f29e38ff>部位</color>可有效削减首领幻影的韧性，<color=#f29e38ff>击破</color>首领幻影会大幅提高首领幻影和其所有部位受到的伤害，并使我方全体恢复战技点并激活终结技。

当<color=#f29e38ff>【浴血人狼】</color>代替我方角色战斗时，会根据受到攻击的敌方目标<color=#f29e38ff>持续伤害类负面状态的数量</color>额外<color=#f29e38ff>无视弱点属性削减其韧性</color>。【浴血人狼】的<color=#f29e38ff>普攻</color>可为我方全体目标回复生命值，<color=#f29e38ff>战技</color>可命中多个敌方目标并大幅削减韧性，且<color=#f29e38ff>不消耗战技点</color>。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：叱咤风云
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影会施放【蚀心厉咒】使我方陷入【厉咒】效果。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在【蚀心厉咒】施放时，优先选择我方非输出角色作为技能的目标。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：席卷乾圜
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影会施放【席卷乾圜，气吞坤矩】造成高额伤害和负面效果。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在【席卷乾圜，气吞坤矩】施放前尽可能击破所有部位。

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：优先消耗战技点获得【荣耀】，可提高造成的暴击伤害，同时提高削减【战甲】的层数。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：临锋决敌
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影和其召唤物的【战甲】会强化为【百炼战甲】。拥有【百炼战甲】的召唤物会令首领幻影的技能获得强化。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在首领幻影每次行动前，尽可能削减召唤物的【百炼战甲】，可以有效削弱首领幻影的技能。

tag_list.name: 坚防守备
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tag_list.name: 铁骨峥嵘
tag_list.desc: 部位受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。当首领幻影被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>

tag_list.name: 钩爪锯牙
tag_list.desc: 首领幻影的韧性提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>点。

tag_list.name: 兽血沸腾
tag_list.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>【厉咒】</color>状态的持续时间延长<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>回合。

difficulty_guide_list.desc: 首领幻影和其所有部位受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
首领幻影的部位被<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>时，首领幻影会削减一定韧性。
首领幻影施放【蚀心厉咒】，使我方角色<color=#f29e38ff>陷入【厉咒】状态</color>。【厉咒】状态下的我方角色及其召唤物离场。同时召唤【浴血人狼】，代替该离场角色继续战斗，并且【浴血人狼】的攻击能<color=#f29e38ff>造成较多的韧性削减</color>。

text_guide_list: 多次击破首领幻影的<color=#f29e38ff>部位</color>可有效削减首领幻影的韧性，<color=#f29e38ff>击破</color>首领幻影会大幅提高首领幻影和其所有部位受到的伤害，并使我方全体恢复战技点并激活终结技。

当<color=#f29e38ff>【浴血人狼】</color>代替我方角色战斗时，会根据受到攻击的敌方目标<color=#f29e38ff>持续伤害类负面状态的数量</color>额外<color=#f29e38ff>无视弱点属性削减其韧性</color>。【浴血人狼】的<color=#f29e38ff>普攻</color>可为我方全体目标回复生命值，<color=#f29e38ff>战技</color>可命中多个敌方目标并大幅削减韧性，且<color=#f29e38ff>不消耗战技点</color>。

phase_list.name: 阶段一：叱咤风云
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影会施放【蚀心厉咒】使我方陷入【厉咒】效果。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在【蚀心厉咒】施放时，优先选择我方非输出角色作为技能的目标。

phase_list.name: 阶段二：席卷乾圜
phase_list.desc: 首领幻影会施放【席卷乾圜，气吞坤矩】造成高额伤害和负面效果。
phase_list.answer: 应对策略：在【席卷乾圜，气吞坤矩】施放前尽可能击破所有部位。

tags.name: 坚防守备
tags.desc: 首领幻影受到的伤害降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。<color=#f29e38ff>弱点击破</color>后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。

tags.name: 双重战场
tags.desc: 首领幻影会在战斗中开启<u>连麦PK</u>，选择一名我方角色前往副战场战斗，其余角色留在主战场提供支援。<u>连麦PK</u>开启后，处于主战场的敌方目标受到的伤害降低，并免疫控制类负面状态，首领幻影进入【<u>韧性锁止</u>】状态。首领幻影的回合开始时，【我方人气值】和【对方人气值】均重置为初始状态。

child.name: 连麦PK
child.desc: 我方全体目标将分别在<color=#f29e38ff>主战场和副战场</color>进行作战。在阿哈时刻以外，不同战场的我方和敌方目标<color=#f29e38ff>无法攻击</color>到另一战场的目标。在阿哈时刻期间，欢愉技始终只能对<color=#f29e38ff>副战场</color>的敌方目标发动攻击。\n连麦PK倒计时结束、处于副战场的我方角色陷入无法战斗状态、处于副战场的所有敌方目标被消灭、副战场没有可以战斗的我方角色，以上任意条件触发时，连麦PK解除。

child.name: 韧性锁止
child.desc: 韧性值无法被削减至低于1点。

tags.desc: 【我方人气值】和【对方人气值】每有一项未达到极限，敌方全体受到的伤害降低。

child.desc: 首领幻影每回合结束时获得一定数量的虫卵。首领幻影可以消耗虫卵强化虫群召唤物，使其获得1层【生长激素】。

tags.desc: 首领幻影每召唤一定数量的虫群召唤物，其召唤的下一只召唤物将自带1层【<color=#f29e38ff><u>生长激素</u></color>】。

child.name: 生长激素
child.desc: 每层【生长激素】提高一定的攻击力，最高可叠加3层。叠加到3层时还将为虫群召唤物解锁额外能力。

tags.desc: 首领幻影每回合结束时和通过【筑巢育卵】获得的虫卵数量提高。

buffs.name: 喜上眉梢

buffs.name: 望风瓦解
buffs.desc: 敌方全体受到的击破伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。击破敌方弱点后，我方全体速度提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>回合。

buffs.name: 登锋陷阵
buffs.desc: 队伍中的第1位角色施放终结技后，使自身的弱点击破效率提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>，暴击伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>回合。

buffs.name: 附骨之疽
buffs.desc: 我方目标对敌方造成持续伤害后，回复<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>点能量。我方全体造成的持续伤害无视敌方目标<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>的全属性抗性。

buffs.name: 智圆行方
buffs.desc: 我方队伍中存在智识命途的角色时，我方全体全属性抗性穿透提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

buffs.name: 前尘影事
buffs.desc: 当前在场的我方忆灵数量大于等于3时，我方全体目标造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>。

text_guide_list: 优先消灭副战场的所有敌方目标，可以令首领幻影解除连麦PK，并削弱首领幻影。
积极攻击主战场的【1号输出端】和【2号输出端】，可以为进入副战场的我方角色提供增益，并削减副战场敌方目标的生命值。

phase_list.name: 万众瞩目的超偶像

phase_list.answer: 应对策略：首领幻影开启连麦PK时，优先选择输出能力更强的角色前往副战场战斗。其余角色优先攻击【1号输出端】和【2号输出端】以提供支援。
